basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old culinary enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I recently discovered the world of smoothies and have been experimenting with different flavors and ingredients. I work as a junior software developer, and in my free time, I enjoy exploring virtual reality and historical documentaries. I'm single and usually browse Reddit in the evenings, primarily between 7 PM and 10 PM EST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've been passionate about cooking since my teenage years, often trying out new recipes and ingredients. My interest in technology stems from my computer science degree, and I frequently engage in self-teaching to keep up with the latest trends in software development. I also have a budding interest in historical military history, which I've been exploring through documentaries and online forums.
